{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any anomalies in customer_age
print("Customer age distribution:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders count:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the conversion rate by segment, but first ensure only completed orders are counted
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate per segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Display conversion rates
conversion_rates"}
